description:
Willingness to travel to client locations.

We are seeking a dedicated and technically skilled **Printer Support Engineer** to install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot printers and multifunction devices across client locations. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring uninterrupted printing services, minimizing downtime, and providing prompt technical support to end users.

Key Responsibilities

* Install, configure, and commission Laser, Inkjet, Dot Matrix, Thermal, Barcode, Label, and Multifunction Printers (MFPs).
* Diagnose and resolve hardware and software issues related to printers and scanners.
* Install and configure printer drivers on Windows and network environments.
* Configure printers over USB, LAN, Wi\-Fi, and Print Server environments.
* Troubleshoot print quality issues such as paper jams, toner problems, image defects, and connectivity issues.
* Perform preventive maintenance and periodic health checks of printers.
* Replace consumables and hardware components including toner, drum, fuser, rollers, formatter board, power supply, etc.
* Configure network printing, shared printers, and IP\-based printers.
* Coordinate with OEMs for warranty support, spare replacement, and escalations.
* Maintain inventory of printers, spare parts, and consumables.
* Record service calls, prepare maintenance reports, and update ticketing systems.
* Ensure adherence to SLA timelines for incident resolution.
* Provide technical assistance and user guidance on printer operations.
* Support large\-scale printer deployments, relocations, and upgrades.
* Maintain documentation of installation, configuration, and maintenance activities.

Technical Skills

* Good knowledge of HP, Canon, Epson, Brother, Ricoh, Kyocera, Xerox, Samsung, Zebra, TVS, and other printer brands.
* Understanding of printer architecture and hardware components.
* Experience in troubleshooting:
* Network Printers
* USB Printers
* MFP Devices
* Thermal \& Barcode Printers
* Knowledge of:
* TCP/IP Networking
* DHCP, Static IP Configuration
* Windows Operating Systems
* Print Servers
* Active Directory (basic)
* Remote Support Tools
* Familiarity with printer firmware upgrades and driver installations.

Preferred Experience

* Experience in AMC/FMS projects.
* Experience supporting enterprise printer fleets.
* Experience working with ticketing tools (ServiceNow, Freshservice, ManageEngine, etc.).
* Knowledge of SLA\-based support environments.
* Exposure to Government, Banking, Education, Healthcare, or Enterprise IT projects.

Pay: Up to ₹25,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Technical Auditor (O&M) – Electrical Engineer/ Mechanical Engineer
description:
**CKDE \& ASSOCIATES**

*Chartered Accountancy \& Technical/Engineering Audit Consulting Firm*

**JOB OPENING**

**Technical Auditor (O\&M) – Electrical Engineer/ Mechanical Engineer**

**About Us**

CKDE \& Associates is a multidisciplinary Consulting, Assurance, and Audit Firm providing independent advisory and audit services to Power Utilities, Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs), Infrastructure Companies, and Private Enterprises. Our practice spans Technical (O\&M) Audit, Engineering Audit, Project Management Audit, Financial Audit, and Governance, Risk \& Compliance advisory across the power and infrastructure sectors.

**Position Details**

**Position:** Technical Auditor (O\&M) – Electrical Engineer/ Mechanical Engineer

**Department:** Technical Audit / Engineering Audit

**Location:** Kolkata\\ Mumbai.

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**Experience Required:** Minimum 2 years in the power sector

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a Technical Auditor (O\&M) with an Electrical Engineer/ Mechanical Engineer background to join our audit and consulting team. The role involves conducting Operation \& Maintenance (O\&M) technical audits of power generation, transmission, and distribution assets, assessing plant performance, maintenance practices, and compliance with applicable technical standards and regulatory requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct O\&M technical audits of electrical systems in power plants, substations, and transmission/distribution networks
* Review preventive and predictive maintenance practices, condition monitoring records, and plant performance data
* Assess compliance with CEA Guidelines, Indian Electricity Rules, the Electricity Act, and applicable CERC/SERC regulations
* Identify equipment reliability issues, control weaknesses, and root causes of recurring failures or downtime
* Review documentation including single\-line diagrams, protection coordination studies, maintenance logs, and shutdown records
* Prepare audit observations distinguishing facts, assumptions, and recommendations, supported by objective evidence
* Draft technical audit reports including risk ratings, impact analysis, and prioritized recommendations
* Liaise with client plant/engineering teams to gather evidence and clarify observations
* Support project management audits and asset management reviews as required
* Travel to client sites (power plants, substations) for on\-site audit assignments

**Required Qualifications**

* B.E./B.Tech in Electrical Engineer/ Mechanical Engineer (or equivalent) from a recognized institution
* Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in the power sector — generation, transmission, distribution, or O\&M functions
* Working knowledge of electrical systems: switchgear, transformers, protection systems, SCADA, and control systems
* Familiarity with preventive/predictive maintenance practices and reliability engineering concepts
* Understanding of applicable regulatory frameworks (CEA Guidelines, Electricity Act, CERC/SERC Regulations) is an advantage
* Strong analytical and root\-cause analysis skills
* Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint); working knowledge of MS Excel for data analysis preferred

**Preferred Attributes**

* Prior exposure to audit, inspection, or quality assurance functions in a power utility or EPC environment
* Experience with thermal, hydro, solar, or wind power plant systems
* ISO 55001 (Asset Management) or ISO 9001 awareness is a plus
* Willingness to travel for on\-site client audits
* Strong written communication skills for technical report writing

**What We Offer**

* Exposure to diverse power sector clients — generation, transmission, and distribution utilities
* Structured learning in technical audit methodology and regulatory compliance
* Opportunity to work alongside senior consultants and auditors on high\-visibility engagements
* Competitive compensation, commensurate with experience

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates may send their updated resume to banani@ckdeandassociates.com \& subhranshu@ckdeandassociates.com with the subject line "Application – Technical Auditor (O\&M), Electrical".

**CKDE \& Associates \| \[www.ckdeandassociates.com]**

*CKDE \& Associates is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, religion, gender, or other protected characteristics.*

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Commuter assistance
* Flexible schedule
* Food provided
* Health insurance

Work Location: In person
